itens.titulo: Chip stocks tumble as Nvidia-led AI rally unravels, tariff fears weigh
itens.descricao: Chip stocks tumble as Nvidia-led AI rally unravels, tariff fears weigh Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA, XETRA:NVD) fell nearly 9%, reversing much of Monday's rally following comments and developments involving CEO Jensen Huang.

Chip designer Arm Holdings PLC (NASDAQ:ARM) dropped 8%, while Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (ADR) (NYSE:TSM), which manufactures Nvidia's chips, and semiconductor equipment maker ASML Holding NV (NASDAQ:ASML, XETRA:ASME) each lost more than 3%.
Memory chipmakers Micron Technology Inc (NASDAQ:MU) and South Korea's SK Hynix fell roughly 10%, giving back some of Monday's double-digit gains.
The Nasdaq fell more than 4% at one stage, while the S&P 500 was down around 2.5%, as investors reassessed the outlook for technology and AI-related companies.
"Investors are back to dumping tech stocks with indecent haste, but now everything else is being dragged into it too," said Chris Beauchamp, chief market analyst at IG.
Nvidia reported more than $40 billion in free cash flow in its latest quarter.
AI company Anthropic (NASDAQ:ANT) also fell 5%, trading below its IPO price, adding to evidence of weakening appetite for the sector.
Brooks said the Nasdaq 100 had returned to levels seen last week, suggesting Monday's rebound may have been a temporary relief rally rather than the start of a sustained recovery.

itens.titulo: JPMorgan Says the Biggest Risk to Stocks in 2027 Is the Fed
itens.descricao: JPMorgan Says the Biggest Risk to Stocks in 2027 Is the Fed Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - JPMorgan targets 8,200 for the S&P 500 in 2027, but names Fed tightening as the main risk to SPY holders.
- Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley both see 8,700, leaving JPMorgan's call below the Street's most bullish forecasts.
The S&P 500 closed at 7,201.09 on Tuesday, down 0.50%.
A few hours later, strategists at JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) published their first full-year call for 2027, with an 8,200 target for the index.
That target implies 13.9% upside from Tuesday's close, which is a solid gain for an index that has slid since its October record.
The team, led by Dubravko Lakos-Bujas, expects S&P 500 earnings per share of about $430 in 2027, or about 15% growth.
Futures price in a near 96% chance of a 25-basis-point hike in December and another in January.
Owning the market through the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEARCA:SPY) makes 2027 come down to one question.

itens.titulo: JPMorgan says the S&P 500 will rise to 8,200 next year because of the AI supercycle
itens.descricao: JPMorgan says the S&P 500 will rise to 8,200 next year because of the AI supercycle CNBC
trechos: The S & P 500 can climb to 8,200 by the end of 2027 thanks to the transformative technology, which remains in its early innings in spite of mounting concerns, according to Dubravko Lakos-Bujas, head of global markets strategy.
The target represents a more than 13% rise from Tuesday's close of 7,201.09.
"We remain of the view that the AI supercycle remains intact with demand for compute still strong and sticky," Lakos-Bujas wrote on Tuesday.

"The large deleveraging seen across the AI complex in recent months should, if anything, extend the cycle." The strategist is not the only one on Wall Street to come out with a bullish prognostication.
Last week, Goldman Sachs issued a 2027 year-end S & P 500 forecast of 8,700.
Morgan Stanley also raised its 12-month S & P 500 target to 8,700 from 8,000.
Those forecasts come amid a period of tumult for the market, which has tumbled far from its October highs above 7,800 as worries about the sustainability of AI spending ballooned.
.SPX YTD mountain The S & P 500 year to date Next year isn't expected to be any easier for the stock market.
